research_question: Can an additional physically measured spectral coordinate reduce collisions in multimodal memory retrieval, and what prior art constrains the interpretation of wavelength, retrieval, associative memory, multimodal fusion and sensor cost?
coverage_boundary: This artifact records a deliberately broad high-recall arXiv sweep. No web or arXiv search interface can certify that every relevant paper was found. Search coverage is strengthened by multiple orthogonal query families and surveys; a citation-graph pass remains the correct next step for near-exhaustive lineage expansion.
query_families: hyperspectral retrieval / semantic retrieval / spectral-spatial representation
RGB-to-spectrum reconstruction / metamerism / camera and observer spectral sensitivity
spectral band selection / mutual information / redundancy / information gain
cross-modal retrieval / multimodal retrieval / audiovisual-tactile fusion
cross-modal hashing / compact semantic retrieval codes
associative memory / Hopfield / context-gated retrieval / transformer memory
episodic and lifelong multimodal agent memory
photonic associative memory / wavelength-division multiplexing / optical neural computing
light exposure / photobiomodulation / cognition as a boundary-control literature

A_ASSOCIATIVE_MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT_GATING.title: Context-Gated Associative Retrieval: From Theory to Transformers
A_ASSOCIATIVE_MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT_GATING.signal: External context can reshape the associative retrieval landscape and increase inter-memory separation; directly supports testing whether an extra cue dimension can reduce retrieval ambiguity without implying that the cue itself contains the memory.

A_ASSOCIATIVE_MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT_GATING.title: Universal Hopfield Networks: A General Framework for Single-Shot Associative Memory Models
A_ASSOCIATIVE_MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT_GATING.signal: Decomposes associative memory into similarity, separation and projection; useful for defining where lambda enters the LIGHTHOUSE retrieval pipeline.

A_ASSOCIATIVE_MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT_GATING.title: Hopfield Networks is All You Need
A_ASSOCIATIVE_MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT_GATING.signal: Modern Hopfield retrieval and attention provide a formal family for high-capacity pattern retrieval and collision behavior.

A_ASSOCIATIVE_MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT_GATING.title: Understanding Transformer from the Perspective of Associative Memory
A_ASSOCIATIVE_MEMORY_AND_CONTEXT_GATING.signal: Treats attention and feed-forward components through an associative-memory lens; relevant to IO tests of cue-driven machine recall.

B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.title: Exploring Multimodal LMMs for Online Episodic Memory Question Answering on the Edge
B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.signal: Shows episodic recall under explicit edge resource constraints, useful for NO_FREE_SEMANTIC_COMPRESSION accounting.

B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.title: Cognitive Prosthetic: An AI-Enabled Multimodal System for Episodic Recall in Knowledge Work
B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.signal: Builds queryable episodic memory from synchronized heterogeneous sensor data and explicitly uses structured JSON-based episodic records.

B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.title: Seeing, Listening, Remembering, and Reasoning: A Multimodal Agent with Long-Term Memory
B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.signal: Entity-centric multimodal long-term memory from visual and auditory streams; strong prior art for audio+visual cue composition.

B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.title: OmniMem: Autoresearch-Guided Discovery of Lifelong Multimodal Agent Memory
B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.signal: Shows that memory architecture, retrieval strategy and data pipeline changes can dominate simple hyperparameter tuning; relevant to TOPA/Spider search over memory representation choices.

B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.title: M2A: Multimodal Memory Agent with Dual-Layer Hybrid Memory for Long-Term Personalized Interactions
B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.signal: Separates immutable raw history from semantic memory summaries, closely matching JANUS provenance-vs-derived-state separation.

B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.title: EgoMem: Lifelong Memory Agent for Full-duplex Omnimodal Models
B_MULTIMODAL_AND_EPISODIC_MEMORY.signal: Retrieves identities and context directly from audiovisual streams and maintains long-term memory over time.

C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.title: Cross-Modal Retrieval: A Systematic Review of Methods and Future Directions
C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.signal: Comprehensive taxonomy of cross-modal retrieval, semantic matching, modality complementarity, benchmarks and metrics.

C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.title: A Case Study on Visual-Audio-Tactile Cross-Modal Retrieval
C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.signal: Demonstrates that multi-modal fusion and dominant-modality selection can improve retrieval distinctiveness; directly motivates BASE vs +lambda vs shuffled-lambda controls.

C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.title: Deep Cross-Modal Hashing
C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.signal: Learns compact hash codes for efficient cross-modal retrieval; prior art against claiming novelty for compact semantic retrieval keys in general.

C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.title: Deep Cross-Modal Hashing with Hashing Functions and Unified Hash Codes Jointly Learning
C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.signal: Shows joint learning of compact cross-modal codes and retrieval functions; relevant to collision and semantic-preservation metrics.

C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.title: Ranking-based Deep Cross-modal Hashing
C_CROSS_MODAL_RETRIEVAL_AND_COMPACT_KEYS.signal: Uses ranking structure to preserve richer semantics than pairwise similarity alone.

D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.title: Deep Learning for Hyperspectral Image Classification: An Overview
D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.signal: Spectral information is discriminative but nonlinear and must usually be combined with spatial context; supports lambda as one feature family rather than a standalone identity oracle.

D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.title: Hyperspectral Image Classification-Traditional to Deep Models: A Survey for Future Prospects
D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.signal: Surveys spectral, spatial and joint spectral-spatial representations and their classification tradeoffs.

D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Band Selection in Hyperspectral Image Classification
D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.signal: Frames choosing informative wavelength bands as a sequential decision problem; strong bridge to Keymaster choosing useful spectral constraints.

D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.title: Band Selection and Classification of Hyperspectral Images using Mutual Information
D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.signal: Uses mutual information and error probability to distinguish useful from redundant bands; direct mathematical prior art for measuring whether lambda reduces collisions enough to justify cost.

D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.title: Band selection and classification of hyperspectral images by minimizing normalized mutual information
D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.signal: Explicitly treats some bands as redundant/noisy and seeks a small relevant subset.

D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.title: A new band selection approach based on information theory and support vector machine for hyperspectral images reduction and classification
D_SPECTRAL_INFORMATION_AND_BAND_SELECTIO.signal: Selects a small highly discriminative subset from many bands while charging computational complexity.

E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.title: A survey on computational spectral reconstruction methods from RGB to hyperspectral imaging
E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.signal: RGB does not directly expose full spectral information; spectral reconstruction is a nontrivial inverse problem.

E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.title: Physically Plausible Spectral Reconstruction from RGB Images
E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.signal: Even learned RGB-to-spectrum reconstruction needs physical consistency checks; reinforces RGB_PIXEL != UNIQUE_PHYSICAL_WAVELENGTH.

E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.title: Continuous Spectral Reconstruction from RGB Images via Implicit Neural Representation
E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.signal: Treats spectral band/wavelength as a continuous coordinate for reconstruction; useful implementation inspiration for a calibrated spectral feature axis.

E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.title: Inferring Human Observer Spectral Sensitivities from Video Game Data
E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.signal: Observer metameric breakdown shows that identical display RGB can yield different perception across observers; blocks simplistic color-to-wavelength semantics.

E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.title: Spectral Sensitivity Estimation Without a Camera
E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.signal: Camera spectral sensitivity is generally unknown and calibration/reconstruction is itself a technical task that must be charged.

E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.title: Understanding Cross-Model Perceptual Invariances Through Ensemble Metamers
E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.signal: Physically distinct stimuli can map to similar internal representations; directly analogous to semantic collisions in a Magic Key.

E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.title: Generating metamers of human scene understanding
E_RGB_SPECTRUM_AMBIGUITY_AND_METAMERS.signal: Shows scene-level perceptual equivalence despite physical differences; another warning that physical signal identity and semantic representation identity are distinct.

F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.title: Neuromorphic computing using wavelength-division multiplexing
F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.signal: Wavelength can serve as a parallel computational channel in optical neural networks without carrying intrinsic semantic meaning.

F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.title: Multi-dimensional optical neural network
F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.signal: Combines WDM with mode-division multiplexing, demonstrating wavelength as one orthogonal hardware dimension among several.

F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.title: Fully multiplexed photonic tensor computing
F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.signal: Jointly uses wavelength, RF, mode, time and space dimensions; strong analogy for treating lambda as one coordinate in a multidimensional key rather than as the meaning itself.

F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.title: Enabling Scalable Photonic Tensor Cores with Polarization-Domain Photonic Computing
F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.signal: Shows wavelength and polarization as separable computational degrees of freedom.

F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.title: Dense Holographic Associative Memories
F_PHOTONIC_AND_WAVELENGTH_MULTIPLEXED_CO.signal: Proposes optical hardware that directly realizes dense associative retrieval; important external bridge between physical optical coordinates and associative-memory computation.

G_LIGHT_COGNITION_BOUNDARY_CONTROL.title: Alertness Optimization for Shift Workers Using a Physiology-based Mathematical Model
G_LIGHT_COGNITION_BOUNDARY_CONTROL.signal: Light schedules can affect circadian/alertness dynamics, but this is physiological control and does not establish a wavelength-to-semantic-memory code.

G_LIGHT_COGNITION_BOUNDARY_CONTROL.title: A pilot study examining transcranial photobiomodulation therapy intervention in college students with insomnia
G_LIGHT_COGNITION_BOUNDARY_CONTROL.signal: Preliminary intervention literature on light applied biologically; must not be conflated with LIGHTHOUSE semantic-key claims.

G_LIGHT_COGNITION_BOUNDARY_CONTROL.title: Transcranial low-level laser stimulation in near infrared-II region for brain safety and protection
G_LIGHT_COGNITION_BOUNDARY_CONTROL.signal: Uses a specific optical regime for biological effects/safety testing; again a different hypothesis class from cue discrimination.

topa_spider_synthesis.strongest_positive_bridge: The literature strongly supports the general pattern EXTRA_CONTEXT_OR_MODALITY -> BETTER_SEPARATION_OR_RETRIEVAL in some systems, but only when the added dimension is informative and properly calibrated.
topa_spider_synthesis.strongest_negative_bridge: Spectral/RGB/metamer literature strongly rejects any naive equation RGB_COLOR -> UNIQUE_WAVELENGTH -> UNIQUE_MEANING.
most_direct_algorithmic_prior_art: Context-Gated Associative Retrieval: external context can increase inter-memory separation.
Hyperspectral band-selection literature: some wavelength bands add information while others are redundant/noisy, and band utility can be measured with mutual information/error reduction.
Cross-modal retrieval literature: additional modalities can improve distinctiveness, but modality weighting and fusion matter.
Metamer literature: different physical inputs can collide in representation space, so collision testing is mandatory.
Photonic WDM literature: wavelength is a legitimate orthogonal computational coordinate without semantic privilege.
topa_spider_synthesis.novelty_assessment: EXTERNAL_NOVELTY_UNESTABLISHED. Individual components are well represented in prior art. The potentially interesting JANUS composition is a cost-accounted, provenance-preserving, collision-tested spectral coordinate inside a multimodal memory Magic Key whose output cannot become welfare authority without separate human consent.
topa_spider_synthesis.direct_effect_on_LIGHTHOUSE_R1: R1 should not ask whether a wavelength 'means' a memory. It should ask whether a measured, calibrated spectral feature increases conditional information about target identity after audio/visual/context features are fixed, under shuffled-lambda and noise controls and with sensing/calibration/verification cost charged.
